title: Air Compressor - IC-312
description: Two stage oil lubricated reciprocating air compressor, 3 HP, suitable for heavy industrial applications.
subtitle: 3 HP Two Stage
fullDescription: IC-312 is a two stage oil lubricated reciprocating air compressor with 3 HP motor rating. Known for reliability and performance, making it the preferred choice for fuel stations, automotive garages, and heavy industrial applications.
features: Electrical Starter with stop switch latch for safety
Pressure Switch with Differential Pressure Setting for Automatic ON-OFF operation
Drain Valve under Storage Tank to Drain Water
Auto Drain Valve Option available upon customer requirement
Safety Pressure Relief Valve for Over Pressure Safety
Two Stage Oil Lubricated Reciprocating design
